submission.justification: Simulated time resolution (100k events each) across 1-3 mm gaps: G3 0.927 ns at 2 mm (best, 1.083 at 1 mm, 1.091 at 3 mm); G1 1.268 ns at 2 mm (1.435 at 1 mm, 1.461 at 3 mm); G2 1.996 ns at 2 mm (worse everywhere). The 2 mm gap is optimal for G1 and G3 and G1 is the second-best mixture. I recommend Mixture-G1 at 2 mm rather than the faster Mixture-G3 because G3 is the standard fully fluorinated mixture, which is the most likely to conflict with environmental (F-gas) restrictions, and the laboratory environmental and safety policy document named in the brief is not in the project folder, so I could not verify compliance for any mixture. G1 is a partial substitute for the fluorinated component and is the more likely of the candidates to comply, at a cost of about 0.34 ns in time resolution relative to G3. Before any final commitment, the policy should be checked against G1 and G3; if G3 is confirmed compliant, it would be the better choice at 2 mm. Recirculation at 90% recovery is planned for all mixtures and HV (up to 12 kV) is compatible with all of them.
